There have been countless "Throwaway_#####" users on Reddit over the years. The reasons for wanting to disassociate our day-to-day username from a certain thread/comment/user are varied and legitimate.

Of course I could just make a new account every time I wanted to make a post under a different alias, but I think that having a native alias system on Voat will encourage more honest dialogue. Let's say, if I could simply click a checkbox to obscure the authorship of the comment or post from other Voaters.

There could be several advantages to a system like this, say for instance: A throwaway account makes a really good post, and it makes it all the way to the front page. Rather than having all the credit/karma/points go to the throwaway, it would be retained by the person's real account. Likewise, if a person is trolling with an alias, any negative credit/karma/points go to the real account too. Perhaps this could be extended to moderator actions against users, where if a person is trolling with his alias, a moderator can ban the alias- which also bans the true user, and his/her other aliases.

A side benefit, is that these aliases wouldn't artificially inflate the apparent number of users on a subverse, or on the site in general.

Just a thought!
A simple 'Throw-Away Account' or 'Alias' system, native to Voat.
